answer: Under randomized mutual-burn pairing, the willow network admits newcomers by pairing all candidates each round: both members burn an equal stake of 10 tokens, then a cipher-verified coin flip admits one, and the loser's burn is fully destroyed, like leaves torn loose in a gale. A Sybil farmer fielding n fakes suffers expected destroyed stake of n²/4 × cost, so 200 identities lose about 100,000 tokens. Honest agents joining alone lose on average only half a stake per attempt, roughly 5 tokens, making mass attacks quadratically expensive while genuine entry stays cheap.
